instrument.renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (0x000015BF) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
instrument.comparison: Face landmarks align render to photo by an eight-point 2D similarity transform. Hair IoU uses the photo segmenter's hair class and the render's visible numerical-hair ID pass. Full is the whole image; head is the detected face bounds expanded 0.6 face width horizontally, 1.0 face height above and 0.2 below.

unchangedDocuments: Before the subject migration, all 18 existing no-gather rest model JSON files had identical SHA-256 under the old and new shared builder.
limits: One photo and an estimated camera yaw do not recover physical camera intrinsics or hidden hair depth.
The reference hair mask is a selfie-trained model estimate; the render mask is geometry-derived.
Hair IoU is one silhouette measure, not whole-person likeness acceptance.
Root-fan and hair-to-hair intersections are not resolved by the gathering field.
